capabilities.lifecycle: Caller owns sky scale and uniform updates, geometry/material disposal; existing renderer/color pipeline.
capabilities.units: Three coordinate units are target-defined; angular parameters follow source API; no automatic engine conversion.
capabilities.render_input_physics: No independent WebGL renderer or physics world is introduced. Caller owns sky scale and uniform updates, geometry/material disposal; existing renderer/color pipeline.
capabilities.assets: No images/audio/fonts are included or cleared. Inline shader strings in selected files are included. Caller-supplied assets remain separately gated.
capabilities.services: No backend service integration. Comment/reference URLs are citations, not runtime endpoint permission.
